full_judgment: 26. While we are on this point let us remember that one basic principle by which the Court should be guided is that, there is always a presumption that government action is in public interest. The Court will not easily assume the action taken by the government is unreasonable or without public interest, it is for the party challenging authority to show that it is wanting in public interest. This burden is heavy and has to be discharged by the party concerned. In the instant case, in our view, the petitioner has failed in this respect.
